items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) listed as full participant Wednesday, first full practice since injury after missing three games; Rapoport confirms first full since ankle sprain.
items.why: First full practice participation post high-ankle sprain; expected to play vs Bills.
items.implication: Major unlock for Ravens pass game and dual-threat upside Week 8.
items.opportunity: Elevates Zay Flowers efficiency and overall Ravens scoring pace.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle aggravated previous chest injury on reverse in Week 7; status for Sunday vs Chiefs TBD based on practice; DNP Wednesday.
items.why: Chest aggravation; availability determined by remaining practices.
items.implication: Iffy for tough Chiefs matchup; Courtland Sutton becomes primary if out.
items.opportunity: Target/snap bump for Courtland Sutton and other DEN WRs if Waddle inactive.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) returns to practice (limited) per Wednesday injury report.
items.why: Returned to practice after ankle absence; Allgeier also dealing with toe.
items.implication: Path back to role; monitor for active/elevated snaps vs DAL.
items.opportunity: Potential reclaim of carries if cleared; depth chart competition with Allgeier.

items.text: Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) listed non-participant at Wednesday practice.
items.why: Shoulder issue; monitor Thursday/Friday for upgrade path.
items.implication: RB1 value at risk if limited or out; David Montgomery or others could absorb work.
items.opportunity: Snap/carry share expansion for Lions backups if Gibbs sits or is limited.

items.text: Lions WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) listed non-participant Wednesday practice alongside Gibbs.
items.why: Ankle; early-week DNP requires monitoring for Week 8 availability.
items.implication: Target hog status threatened; Jameson Williams upside rises if limited/out.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Jameson Williams and LaPorta if St. Brown misses time.

items.text: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase listed non-participant Wednesday due to ankle injury and rest.
items.implication: Likely precautionary but track upgrades; Tee Higgins would see bump if Chase limited.
items.opportunity: Potential target/route share increase for Tee Higgins and Chase Brown in pass game.

items.text: Zay Flowers leads NFL in yards per route run despite 64% targets from Huntley; Ravens 6th in YPP with Huntley 50% snaps. Excited for Declan Doyle offense with healthy Lamar.
items.why: Elite YPRR efficiency even without Lamar; full Lamar unlocks higher volume/ceiling.
items.implication: Flowers massive Week 8 and ROS bump with Jackson return.
items.opportunity: Increased explosive plays, red-zone, and two-minute usage with dual-threat QB.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) DNP Wednesday walkthrough after limited Week 7 return; Barkley said hamstring 'came out great' and does not believe back will keep him out.
items.why: Re-aggravated hamstring plus back lock-up in Week 7; self-optimistic but early DNP.
items.implication: Risky RB2; volume fragile with thin backfield after Pierce IR.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup upside (Elijah Mitchell/Jaydon Blue) if Barkley limited or out.
items.conflict: Optimistic player comments vs early-week DNP.

items.text: Sell Chris Olave or Jordyn Tyson? Prefer selling Olave; rather sell the unproven rookie? No—give me Olave as the one to sell.
items.why: Prefers moving Olave over unproven Tyson in trade discussions.
items.implication: Trade-value signal to sell high/move Olave if possible.

items.text: Keeping it open on Sam LaPorta; could be in for a big day vs Vikings defense that will pressure Goff.
items.why: Matchup vs pressure-heavy Vikings defense creates TE opportunity in Lions scheme.
items.implication: Start with confidence; upside TE1 week.
items.opportunity: Routes and red-zone looks expand if WRs limited or Goff under duress.

items.text: Jadarian Price is BACK. But can you put him right back into your fantasy football lineup?
items.why: Returns from absence but immediate lineup trust questioned.
items.implication: Monitor role/snap share before auto-starting; stash/flex consideration.
items.opportunity: Potential SEA backfield opportunity expansion on return.

items.text: Silva and Levitan: time to move on and move forward with Jonah Coleman in DEN backfield discussion.
items.why: ETR pod consensus shifting forward to Coleman in Denver backfield.
items.implication: Waiver/priority add and potential start candidate in DEN committee.
items.opportunity: Role expansion and carries if preferred over other DEN RBs.

items.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba ripping off ~9 more actual fantasy points than opportunity implies despite losing Kubiak, few dynamic threats, and defenses shading coverage; stadium knows ball is going to him.
items.why: Massive overperformance vs opportunity metrics continues.
items.implication: Elite WR1 floor/ceiling locked in regardless of scheme/personnel noise.
items.opportunity: High route/target concentration and YAC efficiency sustaining production.

items.text: Lions full-PPR PPG: Goff QB2 (behind only Allen), Gibbs RB1 (3.9 clear of Walker), St. Brown WR4 (behind JSN/Puka/Lamb), LaPorta TE6, Jameson Williams WR24. Zero surprise given defense/schedule/talent.
items.why: Sustained PPG dominance across skill positions.
items.implication: Continue prioritizing Lions skill players in start/sit and ROS rankings despite DNPs.
items.opportunity: High snap/route/target shares and red-zone work driving production.
items.conflict: Current Gibbs/St. Brown DNPs create short-term risk vs season-long signal.
